test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ABACK’ is written as 'MECDC' and 'CABAL' is written as 'NCDCE'. How will 'EAGER' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally. ​So, • 'ABACK’ is written as 'MECDC' \
